content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-322. - Administrative hearings.
content.summary:
Any person subject to the provisions of this article may request a hearing on the
               imposition of the admissions tax after receiving a notice of final determination,
               assessment, demand for payment, or denial of claim for refund as set forth in
section 2-171
